verdict.rationale: Neon publishes a live, machine-readable OpenAPI spec (neon.com/openapi.json, confirmed via probe to return HTTP 200 with an 'openapi' key) plus a full Management API reference with an LLM-addressed endpoint index (llms.txt) linking to neon.com/api_spec/release/v2.json for codegen/validation. This directly satisfies the story of downloading a machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of using the OpenAPI spec for codegen in practice (all evidence is first-party docs/probes).
